items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We went to different high schools but we played in one band

ctx.x: I think he was, yeah. I know I wasn’t and I don’t think Sy Toff was. Probably some stocks, you know, Jack Mason, I hope hipper ones than that.
Right, exactly. You also knew Jimmy Rainey and Lou Levy in high school right?
Yeah, right. We went to different high schools but we played in one band, the Harold Fox, “Jimmy Dale” he was known as, the local tailor had a band.
